messages.subject: FeatureCounts --> Nb of reads
parts:
Hi evreyone,

I am dealing with the function featureCounts from Subreads and I am trying to understand the output.
I have multiple exons and I do not know why there is only one column for the number of reads (the last column?). I was expecting to see a list of number for each exons but instead of this, I have only one number and I don't know if it is the average number of reads for all the exons of the gene or the sum of all the reads. This is my output file:

ENST00000000233.9    chr7;chr7;chr7;chr7    127589164;127589595;127590138;127591089    127589484;127590065;127590962;127591212    +;+;+;+    1741    439
ENST00000000412.7    chr12;chr12;chr12;chr12;chr12    8942543;8943536;8943911;8945585;8946406    8943404;8943800;8945417;8946228;8949487    -;-;-;-;-    6360    478
ENST00000000442.10    chr11;chr11;chr11;chr11;chr11    64307505;64314068;64314368;64314912;64315271    64313950;64314238;64314740;64315000;64315706    +;+;+;+;+    7515    0

Thank you for your help.

Baptiste

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: FeatureCounts --> Nb of reads
parts:
Hi Baptiste,

I guess you performed a gene-level read counting, which returns you a single number for each gene for each library. This number is the total number of reads overlapping with any exons in a gene.

If you want to count reads for each individual exon, you will need to specify '-f'.

Cheers,
Wei
